A church where the Word is the medicine.

Faith Clinic is a place to come and get well. Well in your spirit. Well in your mind. Well in your home. We teach the Bible in a way you can understand on Sunday and use on Monday.

Dr. Lee A. Simpson has been preaching and teaching for more than 40 years. He and Pastor Pat lead a church family that prays, believes God, and expects Him to keep His Word.

“So then faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.”Romans 10:17, NKJV
